 1.
The present petition has been filed for disposal of the matter on the basis of settlement.

2. The present petition has been filed for quashing of complaint case No. 291 of 2024 under Section
323, 324, 325, 498A, 406, 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 read with Section 3 and 4 of the
Dowry Prohibition Act.
3.  Learned counsel for the parties state that it was a matrimonial dispute which has been settled between the parties.
Affidavit of service has already place on record.
4. Since both parties are resident of Bangalore, let they appear through Video Conference on 8th April, 2026.

5. Let this matter appear on 8th April, 2026 under the heading "To be mentioned".
(Dinesh Kumar Sharma, J.)
